messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Approvals for reserve changes get stuck when the designated approver is on leave and no delegate is configured, causing claim processing delays.
  quote: We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up... Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup — approval waiting list is blocking everything.
- problem: Reserve authorisation delays halt claim processing when a reserve change exceeds handler limits.
  quote: Yes, it’s specifically when a reserve change exceeds handler limits — the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.
- problem: Reserve adjustments get stuck because the only required approver is unavailable and has no delegate.
  quote: We’re experiencing a reserve authorisation delay because when a handler tries to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it sits waiting for one specific approver who’s out of office and has no delegate assigned, so nothing moves.
- problem: Reserve authorisation delays cause claims to get stuck when the approver is unavailable.
  quote: When a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there — that reserve authorisation delay has caused real issues for us, especially when the approver’s out and no one’s covering.
- problem: Reserve adjustments get stuck in an approval queue when the designated approver is unavailable.
  quote: when a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves.
- problem: The approval waiting list is causing a major delay.
  quote: Not right now — just the approval waiting list is the big blocker.
- problem: Claims get stuck because reserve changes require approval and there is no approver available.
  quote: Hi Bryn, we’re seeing claims stuck because reserve changes need approval but no one’s covering for the approver right now.
- problem: Delays occur because reserve adjustments above the team’s limit wait for a single approver with no backup or delegation, causing claim backlogs.
  quote: We’re running into delays because reserve adjustments above our team’s limit just sit there until the one approver comes back — no backup, no delegation, and claims pile up.
